answer: Every new plume is admitted on the terrace only by burning gale along one global curve: the k-th plume registered within the trailing hundred epochs costs k² gale. The curve is shared by everyone, so splitting a farm across wallets cannot escape it, and a thousand clones at once burn about 333 million gale or must trickle in over many windows. Honest entrants pay a brief premium during surges. It breaks if gale is cheap enough to make that cubic bill affordable.
